text: Lava Foxes (Japanese: , Ferego) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular inside the cave near Infernal Ledges.
Lepyx Elastic Cells are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lepyxes in Primordia or Sylvalum by targeting their legs.
Lepyx Jaw Meats are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lepyxes.

Lava Blattas (Japanese: , Rāva Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 18-20 near Northpointe Beach or at Wonderment Bluff in Primordia at nighttime.

Leroy is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found during the day on the rooftop parking lot southeast of Rosemoss Restaurant in the Commercial District. He is a member of the Outfitters Division.
Letrick is an NPC in and . He is located at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles at any time.
Leandro, the Sneering (Japanese: , Azawarau Reandoro) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Cantor family. It can be found at level 49 at Behemoth's Shadows in Sylvalum.

Legato, the Sky Watcher (Japanese: , Kokū no Regāto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Scintimure family. It can be found at level 45 at Behemoth's Shadows in Sylvalum in the middle of a school of Statue Scintimures.

Laurencio, the Fog Bow (Japanese: , Kiriaka no Rorenshio) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Filiavent family. It can be found at level 59 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum, and will attack if approached. The field track "Z12e201v2e091n4t" plays while close to the Tyrant. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Laurencio, the Fog Bow.
Lethal Vivohasts (Japanese: , Kirā Borunte) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vivohast family, and can be found at level 55-57 north of Lake Ciel in Sylvalum.

Lethal Germivores (Japanese: , Kirā Burōsu, Killer Germivore) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 54-55 in Banshee Cave in Sylvalum.

Lava Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Rāva Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 41-45 in the lava around FN Site 505 in Cauldros.

Light-Speed Jet Fins are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Quick Aetrygons in Oblivia, appearing in the river northwest from FN Site 312 at daytime. One is needed for A Girl's Wings.
Lava Unafulges (Japanese: , Rāva Purumō) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Unafulge family, and can be found at level 41 at Secluded Lava Lake in Sylvalum.

Lethal Unafulges (Japanese: , Kirā Purumō) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Unafulge family, and can be found at level 41-43 at South Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum. Like most Sylvalum unafulges, they may pop out of the ground when approached.
Lifeline is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Winged Viper at rank 7.

Leroy's Ire (Japanese: , Reroi Obu Angā) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell piloted by Leroy, and is fought at level 38 inside Headwater Cavern in Primordia during route A of Forbidden Love. It is one of the two mutually exclusive Enemy Index entries associated with the mission, the other being Loda Gorida.
Lightning Strike (Japanese: , Raitoningushūto) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in . It is a Human-Made Skell and is fought at level 40 at Hilal Meadow in Sylvalum during The Line of Fire.
Lightweight Pelt are common materials in . They can be obtained from Mephites, traded for 34 Reward Tickets, or 10 Material Tickets in . Three are needed for Here Come the Brides.

Lavina Couba is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She arrives in New Los Angeles after Prone Sweet Prone, and can be found at night on a rooftop parking lot near North Founders Street in the Commercial District. After Forbidden Love she moves to the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship.

Leland Cole (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. He is Kiefer Cole's father, despite looking younger than him.
Liceor Horns are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Liceors.
Liceor Sun Beads are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Liceors.
Law is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Human and a member of Wang's team.

Lend an Ear (Japanese: , Kaigan, Enlightenment) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Gu Ladha on the roof of BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Lesson from the Grave (Japanese: , Bohyō ga Oshieru mono) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kupee, who is found at Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum.
Lebora Jargi is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the East Gate in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles during Slovity's Rampage.

The Legen-dar is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from Moimoi by giving him 30,000 Credits near the Mimeosome Maintenance Center in the Administrative District during one route of Setting Forth.

' Lifepod]] Lifepods are Mechanical Field Objects in . They are escape pods which hold crew from the White Whale in stasis. Recovering the Lifepods and bringing the humans inside back to New Los Angeles is one of the duties of the Reclaimers. In-game, none of the Lifepods that can be salvaged in the field are intact, but they give experience, credits, and items. They are not the same as Lifehold units.

Leaving the Nest (Japanese: , Jiyū e no Kettō, A Duel for Freedom) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from De Ezich at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at night. He can be found in the northeast corner, on the far side of the pool.
Leafy Learning is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Sullivan and the primary destination is the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Legacy of the White Whale is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Energy Development Bureau and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Lending a Hand is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Drongo Caravan and the primary destination is Cauldros.

Law and Orders (Japanese: , Ichiru no Nozomi, A Ray of Hope) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received by Wang at Sylvalum's Cleansing Spring during Gold Rush, which requires that this mission be completed. Before or after examining Law during this mission, his Skell's Activity Log can be obtained from the nearby Skell wreckage. This is a piece of mission info intel for the New Los Angeles region. It is not required to complete this mission, and it is not known whether it triggers or is needed for any other missions.

Liana Valdileo is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day. She is Duna Valdileo's and Nemard Wolfen's sister and Auld Belgazus's granddaughter.
Law's Pendant is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received upon completing Law and Orders, and is required to complete Gold Rush.

Lepyx Sunstones are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from brown Lepyxes' back body part. Using a Skell is recommended, as this appendage is difficult to target on foot. They can also be purchased for 36 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in all Resist Virus and Resist.VIRUS augments. Two of them are needed for The Jewelmonger.
Lava Crystals are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Gularth.
Levitath Feathers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Levitath.
Levitath Sun Beads are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Levitath.
Lepyx A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown lepyx variant. It can be obtained from Sirene, the Lost in Primordia.
Lepyx B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green lepyx variant. It can be obtained from Giraffin, the Old Hand in Sylvalum.
Liceor A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black liceor variant. It can be obtained from Stola, the Champion in Sylvalum.
Liceor B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a white liceor variant. It can be obtained from Stola, the Unchained in Sylvalum.
Levitath A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a blue levitath variant. It can be obtained from Eutropio, the Sea Rumble in Primordia.
Levitath B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a purple levitath variant. It can be obtained from Silvestre, the Morning Light in Oblivia.
Levitath C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red levitath variant. It can be obtained from Frajeel, the Purgatorial in Noctilum.
Lifehold Unit is a special Holofigure in . It depicts one of the Lifehold's data units. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Black Lifehold.

Leadership Strike is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.2, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Grexes. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Learning to Share is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.16, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting seven Jaharmums. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Legendary Drake is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.16, and is unlocked if the Weather Altering Device was activated during The Sleeping Lion. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Laying Lophids Low is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers and the primary destination is Primordia.

The Legendary Nopopopopon is a one-of-a-kind melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Longsword resembling a cartoony toy sword. It is obtained from Nopopon at the end of the Normal Mission The Divine Nopopon. It cannot be sold.

Lead Carapaces are common materials in . They can only be obtained from Solid Krabbles in Colony 9, and cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are large shells that emit a sharp light and they are not as heavy as they look.

The level of characters in and indicates how high their stats are, and how well they will do against other enemies. The higher the enemy's level, the harder it will be to hit the enemy or evade its attacks. Enemies that use sight, sound or ether detection will ignore the party, if they are 6 or more levels lower than the party leader and will only attack if the party attacks the enemy. However, Unique Monsters, Bosses and certain Story Exclusive Enemies (such as those in High Entia Tomb) will detect and attack the party, regardless of how high the party's level is, compared to the enemy. The maximum level for party members is 99, and the maximum level for enemies is 120.

Libertas Glyphs are rare materials in . They are glyphs dropped by Unique Monsters between levels 1 and 9. They are the least valuable of the glyphs. Curiously, they can be obtained from the non-unique Pawn Piranhax in Colony 9 that assist Lake Magdalena, but only by using Yoink!. According to their description, the truth of liberty is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.
Leo Feris (Japanese: , Raio Ferisu) are enemies in . They are members of the Feris family and can be found at level 7-9 on the upper right level of the Gormott Province, primarily on Garanti Plain.
Lemour Inn (Japanese: , Yadoya Remureimu) is a Landmark in . It is an inn located in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild.
The Lethal Lysaat King (Japanese: , Kinguritā Shīsu) is a Boss in . It is a Lysaat that is fought at level 2 on the Deck of the Ancient Ship, just before entering the ship proper.

Lethal Lysaats (Japanese: , Ritā Shīsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 2-4 in the Ancient Ship. One can be found at level 4 near Fuel Tank #1 and two can be found at level 3 around Hold #2, all others are level 2. These enemies drop no items.

Lila (Japanese: , Kiku) is an Artificial Blade in . She was built by Professor Soosoo and Professor Tatazo, Tora's grandfather and father, before Soosoo was apparently killed and Tatazo disappeared. She views Poppi as her younger sister.
Les Awfuls are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Haskefell Books in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Agate.

Leftherians (Japanese: リベラリタスの者, Riberaritasu-no-mono, lit. People of Liberalitas) are a race in . They live widespread in the Leftherian Archipelago, primarily in Fonsett Village. Much like Ardainians and Tantalese, they are similar in appearance to humans and tend to be a good-natured, laid-back people, this is likely due to the lack of conflict in the Leftherian Archipelago compared to other regions of Alrest.
Library Philosofia (Japanese: , Firusofia Daitoshokan) is a Location in . It is a library located by Elmos Square in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Lightly Fried Rices are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Rumbletum Canteen in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Leftherian Lives are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased at the Nopox Hobby Store in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of Adenine's favorite Pouch items.
Leaf-Weave Capes are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Neuromin Textiles in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Floren.
Lentil Milkshakes are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Vargel Tavern in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Lectica Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from Lectica Vegetables in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Lectica Vegetables is a shop in . It is run by Lucisthenes and can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal's Theosoir. It is specialized in Veggies.
Lavvade is an NPC in . Lavvade is an Urayan who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. Lavvade runs a shop called Fallone Crafts specialized in Textiles.

Leonine Sadie (Japanese: , Shishiryū Sauzādo, "Lion-Dragon Sauzard") is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Sauros family, and can be found at level 95 in Temperantia, guarding the entrance to the Titan Weapon Dig Site.

Leaf Camills (Japanese: , Rīfu Kamiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Camill family and can be found at level 7 - 14 on the upper right level of the Gormott Province, particularly on Garanti Plain or the Plains of Evening Calm.

Liar Vangs (Japanese: , Raiā Vanpu) are enemies in . They are members of the Vang family and can be found at level 24-26 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province at night, particularly near the small pond near Cape Singbreeze.
Leran Parisax (Japanese: , Reran Parasu) are enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family and can be found at level 54-56 inside the Womb Hollow in the Land of Morytha.

The Leaning Tower of Dorrick (Japanese: , Doreku no Shatō) is a landmark in . It is a stone spire located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, slightly southwest from Titan Weapon Remains and north of Desta Plains.

Leap Pippitos (Japanese: , Rīpu Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 21-23 at Wyrmtears or in the Old Quarry in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Leader's Eyepatches (Japanese: , Haō no Gantai) are accessories in and . They increase the damage ratio of Arts used to cancelling an action by up to 39%. Unlike what the item's description might suggest, the effect will not only apply when cancelling Auto-Attacks, but also when cancelling Blade Switches and other Arts. They are the upgraded version of the Eyepatch. The Hi-Tech Eyepatch and Noise Dampener accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Leopard Blow (Japanese: , Reoparudoburou) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Ether Cannon.
Lazy Crayfish are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point immediately west of the Fief of Forgetfulness.
Libra Stones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Lightning Stumps are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular by the Leaning Tower of Dorrick. They can be used to feed the Ominous Ardun in Torigoth at Kloom Farm for two progress points.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Lavender Potpourris (Japanese: , Rabendā Popuri) are accessories in and . They boost the wearer's resistance to the Taunt debuff by up to 100%, allowing for full immunity to the status. They are the upgraded version of the Mint Potpourri accessory.
Liberion Emblems (Japanese: , Riberion Enburemu) are enemies in . They are Brionac Standards, and can be found at level 60-62 in the Brionac Occupied Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Legendary Core Crystals are Core Crystals in . They can awake a Common or a Rare Blade, and have a better chance of awakening Rare Blades than Common Core Crystals or Rare Core Crystals. They can be obtained from defeating high leveled Enemies, and more commonly drop after inflicting Smash, in particular Unique Monsters such as Relentless Arduran. Superbosses all have a drop rate of 10%, higher than all other monsters. All enemies that drop Legendary Core Crystals also drop Rare Core Crystals, and all except Amalthus and the Superbosses drop Common Core Crystals. In New Game Plus, they can also be obtained from a Traveling Bard in Fonsa Myma, Uraya by trading 200,000 Bonus EXP. In the , Lege

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Launch Resist (Japanese: , Raijingu Teikō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It boosts the user's resistance to the Launch reaction by up to 60%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Light Def Up (Japanese: , Hikari Zokusei Damēji Genshō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It reduces the damage received from Light elemental attacks by up to 35%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Light Reflect (Japanese: , Hikari Zokusei Hansha Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. Every time the user blocks a Light elemental attack, this equipment nullifies the damage taken and reflects it back to the enemy. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
The Letter to Melvin is a Key Item in . It is obtained after defeating the Unique Monster Spring-Shower Elliott at the Lumos Pedestal on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
The Level 2 Access Key is a Key Item in . It is found in the Armory of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. It grants access to the defense door in the hallway next to Olno's Mess Hall.

The Level 1 Access Key is a Key Item in . It is obtained by defeating the Ardainian Sergeant in the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. It grants access to the Armory door in the hallway next to the Sickbay and to the cells in the Solitary Block #1.

Lightocyte is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having him appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point on Funnystone Highway in the Kingdom of Uraya. Upon appraisal, Misimisi states that: "Lightocyte very rare mineral nowadays! Most treasure hunter never able to find! Is said to be more beautiful than any other jewel, due to pathway of light visible inside crystal! Friends take good care of this, mehopes!"

The Lightning Pearl, also known as the Titan Tear, is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having her appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point on the Isle of Sleeping Remains in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is revealed that they are created when Leftherian Titans are struck by lightning, hence the name.
The Lavian Driver (Japanese: , Rabian Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is a Driver, and can be found at level 64 at the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya during Farewell, Good Friend.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Light Absorb (Japanese: , Hikari Zokusei Kyūshū Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . Every time the user blocks a Light elemental attack, this equipment nullifies the damage taken and converts it into HP restoration. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
The Left Golden Bracer is a Key Item in . It is obtained from a Treasure Trove buried on a ledge under the Ruins of Fountain Park in the Kingdom of Uraya during Tranquility.

The Leftheria Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission First Class Freshness!. It enables the purchase of Leftherian Life from the Nopox Hobby Store shop in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Lentil Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Raddon Family. It enables the purchase of Mince & Lentil Stir-Fries from the Gryff Butchers shop at Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

The Leaf-Weave Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Renowned Goods. It enables the purchase of Leaf-Weave Capes from the Neuromin Textiles shop in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

Leg it! is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain automatically after completing the Blade Quest All's Fair. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye", "Earth Mastery" and "Ice Mastery" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Can't Escape.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Leftherian Archipelago. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels. The following Merc Missions become available during Chapter 8: After the party arrives at the Sky Bridge landmark during Chapter 8, the following Merc Missions are automatically transferred from Indol to the Leftheria region. Any mission that is not unlocked before the transfer can still be obtained

Life Goes On is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Shrine of Light in Garfont Village within the Kingdom of Uraya, and is available after Rex has bonded with Roc in chapter 4, even on a second playthrough, and after taking a rest at the inn of Garfont. The location can only be accessed from a underground spring near Garfont Rear Gate, which requires Level 2 "Water Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. Completing this Heart-to-Heart unlocks Roc's level 4 "Swoop" Battle Skill. The conversation centers on Vandham's legacy. The conversation choices are "Do you want to hear about Vandham?" or "Do you wish you could stay here?". Completing the Heart-to-Heart increases Roc's Trust by 900 p
Leadership Qualities is a quest in . It can be received from Yew at Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Len is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago. He gives the DLC quest Beneath the Aurora upon installing the New Quests Pack 2 of the Expansion Pass.
|-|XC2= |-|NS2= Lila's Location (Japanese: , Kiku no Yukue) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received after viewing "Working Together with Mòrag" in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Leonora Aux Cores is a shop in . It is run by Deetta and can be found in the Commercial District of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Aux Cores. Like all Aux Core shops, it does not sell Aux Cores, but is used to refine Aux Cores.

Lelemi Aux Cores is a shop in . It is run by Lelemi and can be found at Elmos Square in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is specialized in Aux Cores. Like all Aux Core shops, it does not sell Aux Cores, but is used to refine Aux Cores.
Lelemi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found at Elmos Square in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. She runs a shop called Lelemi Aux Cores.
Learning New Ideas is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Plaza of Reprieve in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Life Drain is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It restores up to 50% of Tora's maximum HP every time an enemy is defeated. The effect will only activate if Tora lands the finishing blow. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Leftheria Collecting 1 is an Info Item in . It can be bought for a base price of 700 G from the Informants in Leftheria and Indol.
Leftheria Collecting 2 is an Info Item in . It can be bought for a base price of 1,000 G from the Informants in Leftheria and Indol.
Leftheria Collecting 3 is an Info Item in . It can be bought for a base price of 800 G from the Informants in Leftheria and Indol.
* Leftheria Collecting 1 * Leftheria Collecting 2 * Leftheria Collecting 3

Lifeline to Temperantia is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain automatically after clearing the DLC Quest The Lone Watchman. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It uniquely awards more Merc Points than other normal Merc Missions. Completing this mission will unlock the DLC Merc Mission Titan Battleship Fixes.

Lazy Parisax (Japanese: , Dankeru Parasu) are two quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family, and can be found at level 32 in the Dragon's Stomach in the Kingdom of Uraya during the quest The Titan Scholar.
Lesha is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found on Quattor Street in the Indoline Praetorium. She runs Demois Aux Cores.

Legendary Land is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found at the Lv. 2, Mizar: Central Deck in the World Tree. Unlike most other Heart-to-Hearts, there is no dialogue option, and the lines spoken instead change depending on whether or not the player has reached Elysium.
The Leftheria Salvage Points are places in the Leftherian Archipelago in where salvaging can be performed. There are seven Salvage Points in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Lidello is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth's Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province. He can be recruited as the teacher for 7,500 G during the quest Language Teacher, part of the quest School is in Session. He can be found teaching at the Azure Schoolhouse.

Lhagen is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found at Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild during the DLC Quest A Hat Fit for a Lady available as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 3 of the Expansion Pass. She is the daughter of Beemer.
Lhagen's Hat Pattern is an Info Item in . It enables Vale to make Fabulously Fierce Hats at Vale's Weaving. The pattern is received during the DLC Quest A Hat Fit for a Lady.
Lector Bunnits (Japanese: , Rekutā Banitto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be fought at level 26 during the Challenge Battle Grazing Flock .

Lert Skeeters (Japanese: , Reddo Sukīto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 55 during Wave 3 of Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

Lemles Parisax (Japanese: , Remiresu Parasu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family, and can be found at level 66 during Wave 8 of Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.
Lightning Smash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Nia's Rumbling Smash.

Lettina is an NPC in . She is a Leftherian who can be found at the Fonsett Residential Area in the Leftherian Archipelago. She gives the DLC quest Bright Spark upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Lee Soon is an Ardainian NPC in . She is the daughter of Sarrac, and can be found at Smùide Hot Spring in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Hot Spring Bonanza, which is part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Lenka is a young Gormotti in . She can be found in front of the stairs on the bottom level of the Galad Residential Zone in Torigoth after Crossette is awakened. Approaching her with Crossette, Pyra, and Nia in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Crossette's level 1 "Ardent Cooking". Lenka is not known to appear at any other time.
